decision: Represent the Jouncetech role as an ongoing Full-Stack Developer role on asource using high-level product and architecture language only.
why: The portfolio is public, while the source repository and deployment context can contain private implementation, customer, environment, or credential details. The resume should communicate scope without exposing private repository URLs, tenant data, infrastructure endpoints, secrets, or copied internal text.
implications: Keep the public work entry in src/content/resume/alex.json focused on product category, stack, and owned surfaces.
Do not publish the private source repository URL from the resume entry unless explicitly approved later.
Use safe docs and code structure to refresh the wording, then validate the site build.

decision: Use current public GitHub repository metadata from gh to tune the public resume technical range and refresh the public repository stats snapshot.
why: The visible repository set changed materially since the February snapshot, especially around TypeScript AI workflow tools, Go/macOS developer tooling, Convex/SvelteKit apps, Astro frontend work, SwiftUI utilities, Python data work, and Shell/dotfiles automation. The public resume should reflect demonstrated range without committing raw audit dumps or private repository details.
implications: Keep src/content/resume/alex.json technical-range tags aligned with public repo evidence and current commercial work.
Refresh src/content/generated/stats.snapshot.json and the stats section of src/content/generated/snapshot.meta.json when public repo counts or languages drift.
Do not refresh or commit local Claude/private-machine stats as part of a GitHub repo audit unless explicitly requested.

decision: Create a separate A4 PDF CV for a Vue frontend application instead of reusing the generic web resume PDF.
why: The requested artifact needs corporate readability, print reliability, and clear frontend/Vue signal. A dedicated ReportLab generator gives deterministic A4 output and lets the public web resume remain broader while the PDF emphasizes transferable frontend evidence truthfully.
implications: Keep generated PDFs under ignored output/pdf/ unless a human explicitly asks to commit an artifact.
Use scripts/generate-vue-frontend-cv.py for the current Vue PDF and docs/runbooks/create-dedicated-role-cv-pdf.md for future role-specific CV generation and visual QA.
Keep dedicated CVs truthful by presenting target-role focus without inventing commercial experience.
